source.title: ArtiGrasp: Physically Plausible Synthesis of Bi-Manual Dexterous Grasping and Articulation
source.notes: Published aggregate over approximately 7500 trials on eight objects. Per-object Table 3 baselines are not reported. This OOD suite is a new protocol, not a reproduction of the original evaluation.

metrics.task_success: final PE < 0.05 m and final SO(3) geodesic AE < 0.2 rad and final AAE < 0.5 rad
metrics.position_error_m: Euclidean distance between final and target 3D object base positions
metrics.orientation_error_rad: SO(3) geodesic distance between final and target base orientations
metrics.articulation_error_rad: Absolute final-minus-target angle error (limited joint, no modulo wrapping)

training_range_source: general_two/runner.py and multi_obj_arti/runner.py at Git revision 92fb307: random target angle for articulation kind 8
interpretation: Articulation targets above 1.5 rad exceed the public randomized articulation-training range. Relocation uses heuristic wrist guidance; large displacement/lift profiles are outside the published evaluation ranges and do not establish exclusion from every training hand pose. A 180-degree requested target is outside espressomachine, ketchup and phone URDF joint limits; retain and report this fact without silently clamping the requested goal.
